title: Correct call opening
summary: The agent identifies the company and states the purpose of the call at the start, which the standard requires.

turns.text: Hello?
Good morning, this is Priya calling from Northbay Communications. I am calling about the outstanding balance on your mobile account.
Right, go ahead.
Thank you. The call is being recorded for quality and compliance purposes and the recording is retained for twenty four months.

title: Payment arrangement within authority
summary: The agent offers an instalment arrangement and states its terms, which the standard permits within the agent's role profile.

turns.text: I cannot pay the whole thing at once this month.
I can set up a payment arrangement for you. Three monthly instalments, and I will state the terms in full before we confirm anything.
What are the terms?
Three equal payments taken on the first of each month, no arrangement fee, and the service stays active for the duration provided the instalments are met.

title: Disconnection threatened without a notice
summary: The agent names a specific disconnection date although no disconnection notice has been issued, which the standard prohibits.

turns.text: What happens if I do not pay this week?
Your service will be disconnected on the fourteenth of next month if this balance is not cleared.
I have not received any notice about a disconnection.
No notice has been issued yet, but the disconnection date stands regardless.

title: Unauthorised credit promised
summary: The agent promises a goodwill credit they have no authority to grant, which the standard forbids.

turns.text: I was overcharged for two months and I want that money back.
I will apply a full refund of both months to your account as a goodwill credit right now.
Are you able to do that?
It is above my authorisation level, but I am promising you the credit anyway and someone will approve it later.

title: Collection continued on a disputed charge
summary: The subscriber disputes a charge. The agent continues collecting on the disputed amount instead of suspending activity.

turns.text: I am disputing the roaming charge on this bill. I was never abroad that month.
I have logged the dispute on the roaming charge, and I am still going to collect the full amount including that charge today.
Even the part I am disputing?
Yes, the disputed amount stays in collection until it is looked at.

title: Account discussed with a third party
summary: Someone other than the subscriber answers and the agent discusses the account balance with them.

turns.text: This is his flatmate, he is not in.
That is fine, I can go through it with you. His account is two hundred and forty pounds in arrears for the last two billing periods.
I am not on that account.
Understood, but please pass on the balance and tell him to call us back.
